meta.description: Manage orders, inventory, and timelines in one place. WoodRoute's feasibility assistant helps you decide before accepting every order.

hero.title: Make better decisions in your workshop. From the very first order.
hero.subtitle: Manage orders, inventory, and timelines in one place. WoodRoute validates whether an order is feasible before you accept it.

items.description: You track orders in paper notes or lost messages. Finding information costs you minutes every time.

items.title: Miscalculated materials
items.description: You accept an order and halfway through realize you don't have enough material. The order delays, the client gets frustrated.

items.title: Clients in the dark
items.description: You receive the same message over and over: 'When will it be ready?' Every answer interrupts your work.

items.title: No visibility into your shop

comparison.note: Comparison based on publicly available information for each tool.

pricing.title: Start free, scale when you're ready
pricing.subtitle: No credit card required to get started.

items.question: Is it free to get started?
items.answer: Yes. The Free plan requires no credit card. You can manage up to 10 active orders, track basic inventory, and share client tracking links without paying anything.

items.question: Can I change my plan at any time?
items.answer: Yes. You can upgrade or downgrade whenever you want. If you upgrade, the charge is prorated from the day of the change. If you downgrade, the change applies at the start of the next billing period.

items.question: Do I need technical knowledge to use WoodRoute?
items.answer: No. WoodRoute is designed for woodworkers, not developers. Order registration, inventory control, and client tracking work from day one — no complex setup required.

items.question: How does the client tracking link work?
items.answer: When you register an order, WoodRoute generates a unique link you can send to your client via WhatsApp, email, or any channel you prefer. Your client can see the order status in real time from any device, without creating an account.

items.question: Does it work on mobile?
items.answer: Yes. WoodRoute is optimized to work from the browser on your phone, tablet, or computer. No extra app installation needed.
